shorts.title: କାହିଁକି ଭୁବନେଶ୍ୱରରେ ? RBI Data Centre in Bhubaneswar | How It Will Protect India’s Financial Data ?
shorts.opening_line: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) high-tech Greenfield Data Centre and Enterprise Computing and Cybersecurity Training Institute at Info Valley-II near Bhubaneswar on October 25, 2026. Spread across 18.55 acres, the facility will serve as a backup to the RBI’s primary data centre in Navi Mumbai, helping protect critical financial information and maintain essential banking, payment and settlement services during disruptions. The accompanying institute will focus on cybersecurity training, research and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and quantum computing. This project aims to strengthen India’s digital financial infrastructure and improve the resilience of its banking system.
